observations: Photo 0: A red/orange cylindrical gas cylinder lying in a car trunk.
Cylinder has a metal valve and protective collar at the top.
Surface shows wear, scratches, and rust spots, with paint faded in places.
Base has two cut-out foot slots typical of LPG cylinders.
Surrounding items in trunk: an orange dustpan and brush, plastic bags, a white box, and other household items, none belonging to the cylinder listing.
No brand name, logo, or capacity marking is visible on the cylinder body or valve.
A semi-transparent watermark reads 'POSTED ON JIJI NWOBODO PETER' across the image.
